records.subject: spec-guard-a10-native-same-mac-host
evidence: result:Codex to Claude completed two separate idle wake cycles on the same identities; every direct PING and PONG was acknowledged
result:Claude to a real idle Codex Desktop task completed wake, read, acknowledgement, reply, and reply acknowledgement
cleanup:four exact temporary identities, including one discarded orchestration attempt, were retired with zero test unread; the two Codex test tasks were archived
result:the global native preflight returned to the pre-test 21 registered identities and 9 unacknowledged direct deliveries

records.subject: spec-guard-a10-native-rollback-rehearsal
records.reason: Fresh preflight found 21 pre-existing registered native identities, 9 pre-existing unacknowledged direct deliveries, and active-session state unverified. The authorized batch covered only new synthetic identities and messages, so rollback correctly stopped before changing the selector, starting XATS, or altering existing mailbox state.

records.subject: spec-guard-a10-native-promotion-r1
records.reason: The released and installed version passed same-Mac native send, receive, repeat Claude idle wake, and real Codex Desktop idle wake, but A10 R1 also requires a safe rollback rehearsal. Because that rehearsal was blocked by pre-existing state, v0.39.0 is supporting host evidence and does not count as R1; the consecutive-release count remains 0/2.
